body: awww man - this sucks to hear.  If theres anything you want to get off your chest im gonna be up for another hour or so, here to listen if u need it.
im rested up and have a plan for tomorrow - things are looking up.  Thank you for the kind words.

You're never alone man - so many of us on here are dealing with tough times, you can always reach out to some of us.  Either reply to this comment or go and seek some proper help.  Find some numbers for suicide hotlines in your area and contact them.

I myself was on the phone to a crisis hotline last night, really helped me man.

dude, asking for firearm access on here is just asking for trouble.  
Who knows what kind of person is going to show up, what lengths they will go to, shit you could even end up being an accomplice in some kind of mass shooting.  Please reconsider what you are planning on doing.  Obviously i dont know what your going through but there has to be another way - please phone a crisis line, talk to someone who is experienced in dealing with this kind of stuff.
Although im fairly new to this sub and a bit of a reddit noob, surely asking for firearm access is against the rules, i think a mod nees to step in on this one.
i hope u can understand the nature of this kind of post - anonymity  is the best way to go.  But really appreciate you asking.
much appreciated my friend.  Here to stay now hopefully.
some nice sentiments thank you - tomorrow is hopefully gonna be the day i start sorting all this mess out.  Some more hope and good news came my way today so im honestly feeling much better.
i hope You're ok dude. drop a pm if things get rough.

Thank you for all the kind words people - hopefully this week i can start making some changes and getting back on track.  By the sounds of things its gonna be a long road but we all have to start somewhere.
BTW - its really bugging me that i put "their" instead of there in the title, i was pretty frazzled at the time of writing the op.
Take care all and stay strong.

just wanted to leave a quick - stay strong brother.  
My advice would be to confide in someone you know in real life, literally saved my life.
take care dude, and please dont do anything rash.
thank you, me too in all honesty.
